item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:02 HKT 01/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An active southwest monsoon and upper-air disturbances will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week. With the southwest monsoon moderating and an anticyclone aloft covering the coast of Guangdong gradually, showers will ease off and the weather will improve over the region in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be very hot during the day. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Co-May will dissipate gradually over the vicinity of Anhui today.

Date/Month: 02/08 (Saturday)
Wind: Southwest force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will increase gradually.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
